segments.zh: 归根结底，建立强大的安全文化意味着 HazCom 成为一种无处不在的氛围。它不是你

segments.text: annual presentation you sit through, it's a living part of the daily conversation at the bench.
segments.zh: 每年坐着听完的枯燥讲座，而是实验台前日常交流中鲜活的一部分。

segments.text: So, I'm going to leave you with this question to think about. If a chemical emergency happened in

segments.text: readily accessible? Basically, are they ready to do the talking to keep you safe? Take a moment
segments.zh: 能随时获取吗？说到底，它们准备好替你说话、保证你的安全了吗？今天花点时间

segments.text: today to evaluate your own workbench. Thanks so much for joining me on This Explainer,
